items.description: The capital and largest city of Saudi Arabia, located in the center of the Arabian Peninsula. It is a major financial and political hub of the country.
A city in northwestern Saudi Arabia known for its historic sites and agricultural surroundings. It serves as the capital of the Al Jawf province.
An important city in the Al-Qassim Province, known for its rich history and cultural heritage. It is located near the central part of the country.
A historic clay and mud-brick fort in central Riyadh that played a crucial role in the unification of the modern Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
A former historic royal palace located in Ha'il, which served as the seat of power for the Al Rashid dynasty in the 19th and early 20th centuries.
An ancient fortress along the historic Hajj pilgrimage route, built to protect travelers moving between Damascus and Medina.
A historic fortress in the city of Tabuk that dates back to the mid-16th century, serving as a protective post for pilgrims.
A prominent landmark in Riyadh featuring traditional Najdi architecture, now preserved as a museum commemorating the founding of the Kingdom.
A significant mountain near Mecca, home to the Cave of Hira where the Prophet Muhammad is said to have received his first revelation.
